messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text: A rejected request doesn’t keep the refund window open. The policy’s exception for an earlier on-time request applies only if it expired or became invalid before payment—not if a staff member rejected it. So if you request the cushion again, it must still be within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window).
